_comment: Reference values for the MoorAI Intune Win32 app. This file documents the enroll parameters and app metadata an admin fills in; it is NOT read by the agent at runtime (the agent reads %USERPROFILE%\.curaiq\config.json, which Install-MoorAI.ps1 writes). Replace every REPLACE_WITH_* value, then use these when creating the Win32 app in the Intune admin center.

enrollment._comment: Passed to Install-MoorAI.ps1. serverUrl + tenant are required; installToken may be empty for an open console.

win32App.description: On-device guardrails for AI coding agents. Content-free: policy is pulled per-tenant from the MoorAI console at runtime.
win32App._installContextNote: Use 'user' so the per-user config + Claude Code hooks land in the human profile. If you must deploy in 'system' context, pair with the per-user logon task described in ../README.md.

requirements._note: The git install channel requires git + Node.js 18+ on the device. For an offline fleet, host a prebuilt agent tarball and set enrollment.pkgUrl instead.
